digest.component_or_area: inbound probe / absence detection / backend adapter pattern
propositions: Jira-specific REST probe logic currently lives in backend-neutral core module inbound_probe.py, violating vendor abstraction and blocking multi-backend probe support.
Probe mechanics (URL construction, basic-auth GET, status classification) must move to adapters/jira/probe.py while neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult) remains in inbound_probe.py.
A new SupportsAbsenceProbe capability protocol enables backends to implement probe_remote() with vendor-specific logic, allowing routing in run_differs.py without direct adapter imports.
run_differs.py must hoist backend loading before probe dispatch and route through capability-guarded backend.probe_remote() instead of direct probe module call.
Backends lacking SupportsAbsenceProbe must degrade to UNREACHABLE ProbeResult rather than fail or skip classification.
Probe test coverage (classification, config errors, status branches, routing) must migrate from test_inbound_probe.py to new test_probe_capability.py under adapter tests.
